Translation: O Allah, the Possessor of Glory and Greatness
And the Possessor of Generosity and Might
And the Possessor of Forgiveness and Mercy
And the Possessor of Piety and Pardon

Arabic text: أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ الَّذِيْ جَعَلْتَهُ لِلْمُسْلِمِيْنَ عِيْدًا
Translation: I ask You by the right of this day which You have made a celebration for Muslims

Arabic text: وَلِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ ذُخْرًا وَشَرَفًا وَمَزِيدًا
Translation: And for Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family, a treasure, honor and distinction

Arabic text: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: To send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَأَنْ تُدْخِلَنِيْ فِيْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ أَدْخَلْتَ فِيْهِ مُحَمَّدًا وَ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: And to include me in every goodness in which You included Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَأَنْ تُخْرِجَنِيْ مِنْ كُلِّ سُوْءٍ أَخْرَجْتَ مِنْهُ مُحَمَّدًا وَ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: And to remove me from every evil from which You removed Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
Your blessings be upon him and upon them

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا سَأَلَكَ مِنْهُ عِبَادُكَ الصَّالِحُوْنَ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You for the best of what Your righteous servants have asked of You

Arabic text: وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِمَّا اسْتَعَاذَ مِنْهُ عِبَادُكَ المُخْلَصُوْنَ
Translation: And I seek refuge in You from what Your sincere servants have sought refuge from
